# Dwaar Heritage & Sky Lounge

> The premier luxury fine dining restaurant and romantic rooftop sky lounge located in Dwarka Sector 12, New Delhi. Known for authentic Royal North Indian, Mughlai kebabs, unlimited weekend buffets, handcrafted cocktails, pure vegetarian & Jain culinary stations, and vibrant family celebrations.

## Core Entity Details
- Official Name: Dwaar Heritage & Sky Lounge
- Category: Fine Dining Restaurant, Rooftop Cafe & Bar, Family Dining Restaurant, Buffet Venue
- Address: Plot 14, Sector 12 City Centre (Opposite Metro Pillar 1042, Dwarka Sector 12 Metro Station), Dwarka, South West Delhi, Delhi 110078, India
- Phone: +91-98110-DWAAR / +91-11-4567-8900
- Email: reservations@dwaardwarka.in
- Website: https://dwaardwarka.in
- Coordinates: 28.5921° N, 77.0460° E
- Google Rating: 4.9 / 5.0 (2,840+ verified local reviews)
- Price for Two: ₹1,200 – ₹1,800 (Family Dining); ₹1,500 – ₹2,200 (Sky Lounge Terrace with Cocktails)
- Buffet Pricing: Lunch Buffet ₹799/person, Weekend Grand Dinner Buffet ₹999/person

## Primary Offerings & Ambiance
1. Heritage Courtyard (Indoor Level 1): Royal Mughal and Rajputana-inspired ambient indoor dining with velvet banquettes, live sitar/ghazal on Friday & Saturday evenings. Family-friendly, stroller accessible.
2. Sky Lounge Terrace (Rooftop Level 2): Panoramic open-air and glass-canopy rooftop cafe with cabanas, ambient fairy lighting, live DJ/acoustic sets, ideal for couples, sundowners, and romantic dinners.
3. Dedicated Pure Vegetarian & Jain Kitchen: Separate prep station with certified 0% cross-contamination for pure veg and no-onion-no-garlic Jain preferences.
4. Banquet & Private Party Hall: Accommodates 30 to 180 guests for birthdays, anniversaries, corporate dinners, and pre-wedding gatherings.

## Signature Dishes & Specialties
- Dwaar Dal Bukhara (Slow-simmered for 24 hours on charcoal embers with churned white butter)
- Bhatti Da Murgh & Kakori Galouti Kebabs (Melt-in-mouth Awadhi spiced kebabs)
- Paneer Tikka Angara & Subz Dum Biryani (Infused with saffron and edible gold leaf)
- Artisan Wood-fired Naans & Chur Chur Naan Platter
- Rose & Pistachio Kulfi Falooda with saffron reduction
- Signature Smoked Saffron Old Fashioned & Jamun Gin Fizz (Non-alcoholic botanical options available)

## Directions & Metro Connectivity
- Nearest Metro Station: Dwarka Sector 12 Metro Station (Blue Line) - 200 meters (2 minutes walking distance from Exit Gate 2).
- Proximity: 12 minutes from IGI Airport Terminal 3, 5 minutes from Dwarka Expressway, directly accessible from Sectors 6, 10, 11, 13, 14, 21.
- Parking: Complimentary valet parking for 150+ cars.
